sub: Mindustry Tool is free for every player. Donations are optional — anything you give goes toward the real costs of running the site, and none of it is required to keep using it.
agribank-note: Scan the QR code with your banking app to make a transfer. The account details are included in the image.
thanks: Thank you for keeping Mindustry Tool free and open. Whatever you can give is appreciated.
paypal-note: Send a donation through PayPal from anywhere in the world. The payment details are shown in the image.
